## Calendar UI (key files & components)

| Path | Component / role |
|------|------------------|
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/leads/LeadsCalendarPage.tsx` | **`LeadsCalendarPage`** – month grid, meetings from leads, create/edit modal |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/projects/ProjectsCalendarPage.tsx` | **`ProjectsCalendarPage`** – month/week from **task deadlines**; links to project |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/workspace/WorkspaceCalendarViewPage.tsx` | **`WorkspaceCalendarViewPage`** – custom-object records on calendar by date/datetime fields (read-only drawer) |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/dashboard/DashboardCalendarMini.tsx` | **`DashboardCalendarMini`** – dashboard mini calendar + create modal |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/projects/ProjectsViewsBar.tsx` | Calendar view settings / “new calendar” in projects bar |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/router/AppRouter.tsx` | Routes: `LeadsCalendarPage`, `ProjectsCalendarPage`, `WorkspaceCalendarViewPage` |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/utils/calendarLocalDates.ts` | Shared local-date helpers (referenced by calendar pages) |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/dashboard/dashboardIcs.ts` | ICS building (used with email) |
| `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/dashboard/dashboardMeetings.ts` | Types + **localStorage** load/save for dashboard meetings |

## How “events” are created (no Google Calendar ID)

- **Leads calendar:** Meetings are objects in **`lead.meta.meetings`**. Saved with **`updateLead` → `PATCH /leads/:id`** (`/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/api/leads.ts`). Invites/reminders can attach **`.ics`** (email), not Google Calendar API.
- **Dashboard mini:** **`DashboardMeeting`** list in **`localStorage`** key `lumiva_dashboard_meetings_v2` (`dashboardMeetings.ts`); optional email + ICS via `sendEmail` / `buildIcsEvent`.
- **Projects calendar:** **No event creation** on that page—tasks with `deadline` are shown; navigation to `/app/projects/:id`.
- **Workspace calendar:** **No creation** on page—records from **`fetchCustomObjectRecords`** positioned by date fields.

## Google Calendar

**No** `googleapis`, `calendarId`, or Google Calendar integration found in `/root/lumiva-crm`.

## AI integration

- **Lead meetings:** Tools **`crm_list_lead_meetings`**, **`crm_add_lead_meeting`**, **`crm_update_lead_meeting`**, **`crm_remove_lead_meeting`** in `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/ai/ai-tools.service.ts` and `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/ai/crm-ai-tool-definitions.ts` — same storage: **`lead.meta.meetings`** (via lead update logic in tools).
- **Assistant copy** in `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/ai/ai-assistant.service.ts` documents those meeting tools.
- **Workspace views:** `calendar` is listed as an extra view type for AI/workspace tooling in `/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/ai/ai-tools.service.ts` (`WORKSPACE_EXTRA_VIEWS`).

## Backend reminders (not UI)

`/root/lumiva-crm/backend/src/leads/leads-meetings-reminder.service.ts` sends scheduled reminders with **ICS attachments** for meetings in `lead.meta.meetings`.
